notes.title: From the producer of Drug Dealer Simulator – Prison King announced
Introducing Enemy of the State, a top-down noir action shooter
Play the free prologue of MythBusters: The Game. Full game coming soon to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Our publisher, Movie Games, is preparing for the release of the official game adaptation for the legendary Discovery show, MythBusters. 

[previewyoutube=-JfizK_6VQk;full][/previewyoutube]

MythBusters: The Game is coming to Steam on 8 June 2022. And while you’re waiting, we recommend you play the FREE prologue, MythBusters: The First Experiment, which Movie Games has just made available to everyone!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897130/MythBusters_The_First_Experiment/

And wishlist the full game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/811550/MythBusters_The_Game__Crazy_Experiments_Simulator/

Are you one of the people who used to spend hours binge-watching Adam and Jamie busting myths? If you did, this game is just perfect for you!

[previewyoutube=P0vbJDBv748;full][/previewyoutube]

In MythBusters: The Game you will step into a Mythbuster’s boots and conduct crazy experiments from creating the concept, through collecting tools and building equipment to putting together an episode of the show. In the game, you will:
Solve puzzles in the Blueprint Zone to work out the mechanics of each myth
Collect the materials for experiments and craft the equipment to use
Bring the experiment to life by setting it up and testing it out
Confirm or bust crazy real-life myths, or deem them plausible
Build your audience to get as much popularity as you can!

Give it a try!

notes.title: From concept art to the game
notes.content:
Hello, Managers! 

Making a game is like a journey and we want you to experience it with us. Let's talk about how Drug Dealer Manager is coming to life, starting with making game art. 

It all starts with a pen and paper – well, figuratively, we do live in the 21 century. But the beginning of all art is always a sketch. Then we add details, colour it and make it all pretty. That’s concept art. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193743/e22688ebe44d050d86d6025d59022ebc974b77fd.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193743/79f259aab122745b625198ad3cad4e70094c50c0.jpg

When we have a ready concept art, it’s time to translate that into the game. We make a 3D model and then we put it into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193743/e528bb970bc08871b971dafdb28cc0cd0ff32c83.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193743/9cc56e71d4e053bdde4310e4ce9c5887ff381f1f.jpg

And btw, what’s that building you see here? 

It’s one of the resident buildings in the Ghetto, the poorest districts in the game. The Ghetto is characterized by the fact that people living there tend to do hard drugs and often die from overdosing them. It's awful, but it’s good for your business. People there rarely care about the quality of the drugs you sell them as long as they’re cheap. You don’t have to worry about losing clients if you dilute the dope too much. 

Houses in this area are cheap but you need to take into consideration that this district is patrolled more often. So if anything shady is taking place here, the police will arrive faster than usual. It’s mostly for show though, as the police cares little about the residents. It’s good for business because the interest of the police about the buildings there grows much slower.

This particular building is a residential house so it lowers the costs of keeping your underlings. You can also turn it into a distribution point, a warehouse or a field laboratory for diluting drugs. It’s not very good as a cover for the money laundering business, tho.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193743/653e186b70b2015be014a82799334d1d66b4ad51.gif

Sounds fun? Let us know if you’d like to see more fun facts like this one! Also, wishlist the game *wink wink*

See ya!
